program = '''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    separator_rows = {r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    separator_cols = {c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1}
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if r in separator_rows or c in separator_cols:
                out[r][c] = 2
    return out
'''
